title: Clo Zfab Kit Launch Event Hong Kong
description:
We launched the new CLO zFab Kit in Hong Kong providing hands on live demo and presentations. Our Maximizing Value through Collaborative Data-Driven Solutions presentation emphasized the importance of collaboration among brands, vendors, and suppliers. 

Powered by CLO AI, the CLO zFab Kit empowers brands, vendors, and suppliers to create accurate, high-quality digital representations of fabrics with ease and precision. Learn more: https://zfabkit.clo3d.com/

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/ar...

transcript: How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? We were very much waiting for the Z-Fab Kit. The fabric digitization part, but also the virtual fitting that it can do, and the use of AI, like how Chloé is helping us to explore that, it's very exciting to see. How did you feel when you first saw the Z-Fab Kit? The explanation is very detailed, and I was very patient when I did the demo. The system's feedback from my colleagues was very positive. Compared to the old set, it's a very different improvement. The old set was mainly manual, and a lot of work needed to be done by hand. The new set successfully eliminated the manual operation. In addition, the software is highly automated. There's a lot of auto-generation and tiling, and it's very easy to do. My colleagues are very happy and looking forward to it. The biggest takeaway is that, you know, AI has become such a big topic in the industry, but it's kind of like where to start. So I like that in the presentation, she touched base on what's going to come out and the features, but also like how to start setting it up in the company and actually implement it in the workflow. And then for the fabric scanner, it's really interesting for us as we're always focusing on building our digital material libraries. So to have a more innovative tool to make it more accurate and more usable is very interesting for us. Thank you very much.
